mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, status FROM agent_run WHERE id = #{runId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT lead_id FROM agent_lead_creation WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO agent_lead_creation (run_id, enterprise_id, project_id) VALUES (#{runId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{projectId})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_lead_creation SET lead_id = #{leadId} WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_lead_evidence (lead_id, signal_id, source_record_id, evidence_type, title, summary, source_url, confidence) SELECT #{leadId}, s.id, r.id, s.signal_type, s.title, s.detail, s.source_url, s.confidence FROM ent_company_signal s JOIN collector_record r ON r.id = s.source_record_id AND r.enterprise_id = s.enterprise_id WHERE s.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND s.signal_type IN ('RECRUITMENT', 'RENTAL') AND r.record_type = s.signal_type AND r.validity_status = 'VALID' AND COALESCE(LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.raw_payload, '$.demo'))), 'false') IN ('false', '0') AND COALESCE(r.published_at, s.observed_at) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND COALESCE(r.published_at, s.observed_at) <= NOW() AND (s.expires_at IS NULL OR s.expires_at >= NOW()) AND s.id IN #{signalId}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.signal_id, e.source_record_id, e.evidence_type, e.title, e.summary, e.source_url, e.confidence, e.created_at, r.source, r.published_at, r.fetched_at, r.validity_status FROM crm_lead_evidence e LEFT JOIN collector_record r ON r.id = e.source_record_id WHERE e.lead_id = #{leadId} ORDER BY e.id

SELECT s.run_id, s.total_score, s.fit_score, s.intent_score, s.confidence_score, s.grade, s.reasons, e.name AS enterprise_name, e.uscc, e.business_status, e.registered_address, e.industry_name FROM agent_lead_creation c JOIN crm_lead_score s ON s.run_id = c.run_id AND s.enterprise_id = c.enterprise_id AND s.project_id = c.project_id JOIN ent_enterprise e ON e.id = c.enterprise_id WHERE c.lead_id = #{leadId} AND s.score_model_version = 'V2' ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1
